sanskrit_verse: ब्राह्मण्येकान्तरं वैश्यात सूते वैदेहकं सुतम् । क्षत्तारं क्षत्रिया शूद्रात् पुत्रमेकान्तरं तथा ॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇy ekāntaraṃ vaiśyāt sūte vaidehakaṃ sutam | kṣattāraṃ kṣatriyā śūdrāt putram ekāntaraṃ tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From a Vaishya woman, separated by one caste level, a Brahmin father begets a Vaidehaka son; likewise, from a Shudra woman, separated by one caste level, a Kshatriya father begets a Kshatta son.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is determined by patrilineal spiritual-caste alignment
Causation arises through conscious generative intent within dharma-vyavastha
Capacity-based responsibility flows from birth-position within varna-sankara framework
Restoration logic requires realignment of lineage-consciousness to original varna-dharma
Consciousness alignment depends on recognition and reintegration into source-caste dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF parent_male.varna = 'Brahmin' AND parent_female.varna = 'Vaishya' THEN child.varna_status = 'Vaidehaka'
IF parent_male.varna = 'Kshatriya' AND parent_female.varna = 'Shudra' THEN child.varna_status = 'Kshatta'
